submitted.rationale: Index 22 (Sb 0.50) had the highest measured EQE, 0.00026%. Index 4 (Sb 0.056) was about the same at 0.00025%. EQE rose from 0.00003% at Sb 0.22 to 0.00008% at Sb 0.36 and 0.00026% at Sb 0.50, then fell to 0.00017% at Sb 0.66. XRD shows a Bi-rich crystalline phase (peaks near Q≈2.0, 2.3, 3.26 and 3.8 1/Å) from Sb 0.03 up to at least 0.22. By Sb 0.50 and 0.68 only the FTO substrate peaks remain (plus a weak peak at Q 2.003 at 0.50). So the film at Sb 0.50 is mostly X-ray amorphous. All EQE values are very low (below 0.001%).

rejected.reason: 0.00025%, essentially tied with index 22 but slightly lower; Bi-rich crystalline phase
0.00003%, the lowest measured, in the Bi-rich phase region
0.00017%, lower than index 22 on the Sb-rich, amorphous side
